_about: Single source of truth for the Radha's Homemade Q&A assistant. The assistant may only say what is in this file. Update this file when the menu, ordering or events change. Recipes and 'more ways' come from the product labels (Oct 2026).

business.name: Radha's Homemade (Radha's Kitchen)
business.tagline: 15-minute dinners from family recipes and real spices. Homemade, small batch, no preservatives.

ordering.how: Pay on Cash App, then call or text Radha with your order and a pickup time.
ordering.prices: Prices change with the weekly menu. Call or text 832-477-1643 for this week's menu and prices.
ordering.pickup: Pickup is in Katy. The pickup time is arranged when you call or text your order.
ordering.delivery: Local delivery is available around Katy. Call or text to check your address and arrange a time.
ordering.hours: There are no fixed shop hours. Call or text to arrange a pickup time.

events.name: Old Katy Farmers Market
events.details: Samples of Butter Masala, Spinach Masala and Chickpea Masala.

categories.name: 15-Minute Dinners
categories.what: Fully cooked curry sauces in 16 oz pouches. Vegetarian sauces: just add your protein or veggies.
categories.how_to_use: Brown your protein or veggies, pour in the sauce with a splash of water, and simmer for about 10 minutes.

items.name: Butter Masala
items.notes: For butter chicken: brown the chicken, add the sauce with a cup of water and a cup of cream, and simmer for 10 minutes. Also works as a pizza base, pasta sauce, for wings or in sandwiches.
items.recipe: Easy Butter Chicken (3 lb chicken): cook the chicken with 3 tbsp butter, add the full packet + 1 cup water + 1 cup cream, simmer 2–3 minutes, adjust salt and serve.
items.more_ways: pizza base, pasta sauce, wings, sandwiches

items.name: Curry Masala Paste
items.recipe: Easy Chicken Curry (4 lb chicken): add the paste to the chicken and cook until done, add up to 1 cup water for your consistency, adjust salt, and serve with rice or naan.
items.more_ways: vegetable curry, marinate and air-fry wings, shrimp coconut curry

items.name: Chana Masala Sauce
items.recipe: Easy Chana Curry (full packet + 52 oz chickpeas): drain and rinse the chickpeas, add them with the sauce and up to 1 cup water, simmer 5 minutes, then adjust water and salt.
items.more_ways: vegetable curry, chana bowls, wraps, rice bowls

items.name: Spinach Masala Sauce
items.recipe: Easy Spinach Paneer (2 lb paneer): add paneer cubes + 1 cup water + 1 cup cream to the sauce, simmer 4–5 minutes until heated through, adjust salt, and add green chilies for extra heat.
items.more_ways: pizza base, pasta sauce, sandwich spread, easy chicken curry

items.name: Peanut Sesame Masala Sauce
items.recipe: Easy Eggplant Curry (full packet + 2 large eggplants): cut the eggplants into wedges and sauté in 3 tbsp oil until lightly browned, add the sauce + 1 cup water, cover and simmer until tender, then adjust salt.
items.more_ways: bell pepper curry, cauliflower curry, mixed vegetable curry

items.name: Meat Masala Sauce
items.recipe: Easy Meat Masala Curry (4 lb meat): add the meat + sauce + 1 cup water, cook until the meat is tender and fully cooked, adding water as needed, then adjust salt and serve with rice or naan.
items.more_ways: goat, lamb or beef curry, meat and potato curry

items.name: Fish Masala Sauce
items.recipe: Easy Fish Masala Curry (full packet + 3 lb fish): bring the sauce + 1 cup water to a simmer in a wide pan, add the fish and cook gently until fully cooked, then adjust water and salt.
items.more_ways: egg curry, shrimp curry, seafood stew, fish tacos

categories.name: Lentil Curries
categories.what: Ready to eat. Thaw and serve, or add water for a hearty lentil soup.

items.name: Five-Lentil Dal

items.name: Kidney Beans Masala
items.notes: Fully cooked: warm it in a pot for a few minutes and pour it over rice.
items.recipe: Ready to eat: thaw, heat and serve. Add water for a hearty soup.

items.name: Chana Masala Curry

items.more_ways: rice, roti or naan, chana bowls, wraps

allergens_from_names: Ingredient names only: Tomato Peanut Chutney has peanuts, Cilantro Coconut Chutney and Turmeric Coconut Rice have coconut, and Protein Bites have nuts. For any allergy, please check with Radha before ordering.
